title: MoodCast Eva: Weather-Triggered Ads

characters.name: Eva
characters.design: friendly young woman with long wavy brown hair and a warm confident smile, wearing a grey t-shirt with the 'MoodCast' logo across the chest and blue jeans
characters.voice: friendly upbeat young woman marketing presenter voice, warm and energetic

scenes.description: Eva stands on a bright sunny city street with golden sunlight, gesturing toward a glowing digital billboard beside her that shows a colorful ice cream advertisement
scenes.motion: gentle camera push-in, Eva gestures toward the glowing billboard, sunlight flares softly

lines.speaker: Eva
lines.text: Sun's out? MoodCast just switched every ad to ice cream.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.voice: warm confident male narrator voice, marketing tone

scenes.description: Eva stands on a rainy city street holding a red umbrella, wearing a bright yellow raincoat with the hood down, rain falling around her, a digital billboard behind her shows a steaming coffee advertisement, puddle reflections on the pavement
scenes.motion: rain falling steadily, Eva tilts her umbrella and smiles, camera slowly orbits

lines.speaker: Eva
lines.text: Forecast says rain? Your ads say hot coffee.

scenes.description: Eva in a cozy winter street scene with snow falling gently, wearing a warm red quilted winter coat and a soft cream knitted scarf, warm shop lights glowing, a digital billboard shows a colorful winter jacket sale advertisement
scenes.motion: snowflakes drifting down, Eva points at the billboard with a delighted closed-mouth smile, warm light glow
scenes.ambience: Sound: hushed winter silence - only a soft breeze and the quiet muffled hush of falling snow, nothing else

lines.speaker: Eva
lines.text: Snow in the forecast, parkas in the ads. That's MoodCast.

music_prompt: upbeat modern marketing music, light electronic pop with acoustic guitar, friendly and optimistic, no vocals
